rules.statement: A partition decree, though only an interlocutory decree under section 9 of the Partition Ordinance, is conclusive against the parties to it so long as it stands unreversed.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think, therefore, here we must, in the case of a conflict of collective judgment, as Layard C.J. prognosticated at page 180 in Perera v. Perera, determine which decision we must follow, and I have no hesitation in agreeing with my Lord that the decision of Bonser C.J. in Peris et al. v. Perera et al. (ubi supra) is the correct one, and in accordance with the intention of the Legislature"
